items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah, I played with Twat. Twat used to play with him. When I was with Thomas, Twat was with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, I played with Twat. Twat used to play with him. When I was with Thomas, Twat was with him. Yeah, Twat, then, that's with Thomas a pretty good while now. Thomas comes by here now sometime. He come here and sit down, me and him talk over the old times. Sometime he want me to come over there, come down there where they play him at, round on Bourbon Street sometime. I tell him, one of these nights I'm going to come down there, you know?
Well, you have to come see me when you do that.
